integrity: Within any clique blade, all selected outer vertices have the same multiset representation and all unselected outer vertices have the same representation. Because blade vertices are pairwise adjacent, finite local multiset dimension therefore forces each blade to contain at most two outer vertices. For triangle blades, exactly one outer vertex per blade is necessary and sufficient, producing the exact dimension and basis count; for larger cliques the pigeonhole obstruction is absolute.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to one-vertex amalgamations of complete graphs with at least two copies.
No claim is made for edge amalgamations, larger common subgraphs, or noncomplete blades.
The computational enumeration is corroborative only; the universal theorem is proved structurally.
A differently phrased or non-indexed correction to the published complete-graph amalgamation statement may exist.
title: Local multiset dimension of clique amalgamations: the finite boundary
